note: Twinking hinges on enchants with no level requirement (flagged noLevelReq): they let a level-19 character carry effects far above the bracket's natural power. Head has no enchant at this bracket, which is why Engineering goggles matter. Verify exact values against Wowhead at authoring time.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Fiery Weapon
enchants.notes: The iconic melee twink weapon enchant; no level requirement lets a 19 carry a proc far above the bracket.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Crusader
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: +100 Strength for 15s and a small heal.
enchants.notes: Big burst window on proc; healers also run it on a caster weapon for the heal.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Icy Chill
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: frost damage and a movement/attack-speed slow.
enchants.notes: Control option for melee; the slow is valuable for kiting and flag-carrier pressure.

enchants.name: Enchant 2H Weapon - Greater Agility
enchants.notes: Flat agility stat stick for two-handers; verify current 1H alternatives per spec.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Greater Intellect
enchants.notes: Caster stat stick for larger mana pool and crit; verify exact enchant per weapon type.

enchants.name: Enchant Boots - Minor Speed
enchants.notes: Movement speed is highly valued in WSG, especially for flag carriers; a near-universal boots pick.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Constitution
enchants.notes: Zul'Gurub-style head/leg arcanum with no level requirement; the defensive head/leg enchant for survivability builds. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Voracity
enchants.notes: Offensive head/leg arcanum with no level requirement; the agility head/leg enchant for damage builds. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Might of the Scourge
enchants.effect: +26 Attack Power and +1% critical strike chance.
enchants.notes: Shoulder enchant with no level requirement; a strong melee/physical shoulder pick. Verify exact values and availability at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Greater Resistance
enchants.notes: All-resistance cloak enchant; a balanced defensive back pick. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Greater Nature Resistance
enchants.notes: Nature-resistance cloak enchant; situational against nature-heavy matchups (e.g. shaman, druid, hunter). Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Major Health
enchants.notes: Flat health chest enchant for survivability builds. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Greater Stats
enchants.notes: All-stats chest enchant for balanced/offensive builds. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Superior Stamina
enchants.notes: Stamina bracer enchant for survivability builds. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Superior Strength
enchants.notes: Strength bracer enchant for melee damage builds. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Superior Agility
enchants.notes: Agility gloves enchant; a strong pick for physical damage classes. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Lifestealing
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: deal Shadow damage and heal the attacker for the amount dealt.
enchants.notes: Sustain weapon enchant with no level requirement; favored on midfield/duelist builds for self-healing. Verify exact value at authoring.

enchants.name: Accurate Scope
enchants.effect: +3 weapon damage (applies to a bow, crossbow, or gun).
enchants.notes: Engineering ranged-weapon scope with no level requirement; flat damage on a bow/crossbow/gun. Verify exact value at authoring.
